title: MetroDom Control API v0 stream events
description: One JSON text frame per event on GET /api/v0/stream (a WebSocket, subprotocol metrodom.v0). `seq` counts up from 1 per connection. On connect the server sends `hello`, then `state`, `queue` and `instruments`. See docs/references/control-api.md.

positionEveryMs.description: How often position events come while playing.

oneOf.description: Sent on connect and whenever anything but the position changes. Same shape as GET /state.
Sent on connect and whenever the queue changes (a song queued, moved, removed, or the set moved on). Same shape as GET /queue.
While playing: the song moment being heard.
Sent on connect, when an instrument connects or disconnects, and when its latency check changes. Same items as GET /instruments.
A line for people: section changes, panic, unplug/replug, tempo set while waiting.
